name: MARS-Hyperspectral cross-sensor transfer feasibility and acquisition protocol
research_question: Can independently analyst-reviewed hyperspectral observations add enough leakage-safe, near-simultaneous Sentinel-2 or Landsat supervision to break the saturated MARS-S2L scene-ranking ceiling?

known_before_freeze: The pinned public repository contains EMIT, PRISMA, and EnMAP 256-by-256 samples plus separate full-granule evaluation folders.
The paper reports analyst-verified plume and plume-free observations with exact UTC acquisition times and global coverage.
The dataset card states that info.json:isplume describes source provenance and is not the authoritative binary mask label.
EMIT split CSVs omit crop coordinates; EnMAP and PRISMA all_events.csv files include latitude and longitude.
Representative location names such as Iq_19 and EMIT_0064 also exist in the local MARS-S2L source archive, so physical-source leakage is expected and must be removed.
No MARS-Hyperspectral plume mask, raster value, full-granule label, or target-sensor pairing outcome has been opened for this experiment.
timing_disclosure.interpretation: The source, revision, paper claims, schemas, and representative identifiers were inspected only to design this protocol. They do not establish transferable target-sensor signal or model improvement.

protected_boundaries.mars_hyperspectral_train: Eligible for auxiliary training only after all gates pass.
protected_boundaries.mars_hyperspectral_validation: External diagnostic only; never fit weights, thresholds, or architecture choices.
protected_boundaries.mars_hyperspectral_test: Sealed until a candidate and operating point are frozen.
protected_boundaries.mars_hyperspectral_fulltiles: Sealed full-granule operational evaluation; never used for training or selection.
protected_boundaries.mars_s2l_official: No official label, mask, model score, or outcome may be opened during acquisition or candidate selection.
protected_boundaries.mars_s2l_development: Only authorized folds 3 and 4 may be used for post-acquisition architecture selection under an independently frozen modeling protocol.

metrics: sample and unique-location counts by source sensor and published split
exact location-name overlap with every MARS-S2L split
25 km overlap where coordinates are present or safely resolved by exact physical-location identity
existing local Sentinel-2 or Landsat acquisition matches within 15 minutes, 1 hour, and 6 hours
unresolved EMIT location count requiring raster georeferencing
stage_a_metadata_audit.failure_action: Stop before mask download and report that the public archive cannot provide enough target-domain temporal overlap.
stage_a_metadata_audit.pass_action: Authorize Stage B only; do not authorize model training.

stage_b_label_and_catalog_audit.eligibility: Stage A must pass every gate.
downloads_permitted: train-split info.json records needed to resolve metadata
train-split plumemask.tif rasters as the smallest authoritative georeferenced labels
downloads_forbidden: hyperspectral retrieval or RGB rasters before a separate modeling protocol

label_contract.authoritative_presence: plumemask.tif contains at least one positive pixel
label_contract.authoritative_absence: plumemask.tif is all zero and the sample belongs to the authors' reviewed plume-free training archive
label_contract.forbidden_shortcut: Never use info.json:isplume or CSV isplume as target truth.
label_contract.positive_transfer: A Sentinel-2 or Landsat scene within 6 hours is an exploratory scene-presence label; only offsets at or below 1 hour are high-confidence.
label_contract.negative_transfer: A reviewed hyperspectral non-detection may not become a target-sensor no-plume label beyond 1 hour. At larger offsets it may identify a persistent surface confounder but may not supervise scene absence.
label_contract.dense_transfer: A hyperspectral mask may supervise target-sensor pixels only at offsets at or below 15 minutes and after exact geospatial reprojection; otherwise it is not a dense target mask.
label_contract.unobservable: Cloud, invalid coverage, insufficient clear fraction, or missing exact target coverage becomes UNOBSERVABLE, never NO_PLUME.

target_catalogs.sentinel_2: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L1C exact acquisition metadata and bands B02/B03/B04/B08/B11/B12
target_catalogs.landsat: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-1 exact acquisition metadata and MARS-S2L-compatible bands

stage_b_label_and_catalog_audit.failure_action: Stop before model design or bulk target imagery download; retain only compact audit receipts.
stage_b_label_and_catalog_audit.pass_action: Preregister a cross-modal teacher/student architecture and target-imagery acquisition manifest before downloading target bands or opening MARS-S2L development outcomes.

architecture_hypothesis_if_and_only_if_s.name: Product-specific stems with a shared plume-object latent and decoupled scene/dense heads
architecture_hypothesis_if_and_only_if_s.hypothesis: Real analyst-reviewed cross-sensor plume and confounder supervision can improve geographic generalization beyond synthetic plume morphology or another MARS-only score head.
constraints: Hyperspectral retrieval channels are training-only teacher inputs; deployment remains the exact MARS-S2L Sentinel-2/Landsat contract.
Synthetic Gaussian data may initialize the dense decoder only and may not supervise the scene head.
Scene and dense losses remain decoupled by label confidence and temporal-alignment tier.
Location coordinates are used only for leakage control and grouping, never as model features.
No validation/test hyperspectral sample or official MARS-S2L outcome may influence fitting.

claim_boundary: Passing either acquisition stage establishes data feasibility only. It does not establish target-sensor methane truth, complementarity, generalization, calibration, or superiority over MARS-S2L.
